description: Completed a Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology at MIT College of Engineering, Pune, affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University. Graduated with an overall score of 70.84%. Developed a final-year thesis project, Adaptive Test Preparation System, focused on personalized learning and student performance analysis.
achievements: Graduated with a Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology with an overall score of 70.84%.
Designed and developed 'Adaptive Test Preparation System' as the final-year thesis project.
Built an adaptive learning platform that adjusted question difficulty based on students' previous performance.
Developed a rule-based recommendation engine to identify weak topics and suggest targeted MCQs and descriptive questions.
Implemented a dashboard with performance visualizations to help students track learning progress.
